name: datasette-representation-discovery-and-f23b
instr:
Datasette cannot currently keep request-aware output format discovery, addressing, negotiation, routing, and export links in agreement. Build one representation model that preserves established behavior.

`Representation` and `RepresentationCatalog` from `datasette.representations` must expose immutable descriptors and enumerate each effective renderer identity once, including built-in JSON and registered plugins. Availability must use populated view data, respect authorization and existing exception handling, and never execute renderer callbacks. A data-sensitive plugin must appear only when that data permits it.

`representation_path` and `representation_links` from `datasette.representation_links` must produce deterministic alternate targets and a tuple of relations without changing encoded routed identity, dotted names, or existing query data. A request's `representation_target` must contain its raw routed path and original query sequence, never its origin. Following every advertised representation of an encoded compound row identifier must reach the same authorized row.

Every eligible generic or row HTML response must advertise exactly its request-available representations. Descriptors, Link headers, head elements, and export presentation must use identical targets and media types. Catalog-backed response headers and rendered head elements must agree exactly.
